notes.title: Version 0.77.1 released!
notes.content:
NEW FEATURE - Chellenge - master your strategy on selected map and compete with other players on Leaderboards! It's experimental feature and not yet well tested, please tell me about any problems.

There also many smaller improvements:
- in the map editor you can now draw with biger brush
- radioactive contamination wears off with time
- you can change visual style of any map before you play
And many others...
